passages.title: 半夜廚房的怪聲
passages.text: Last Friday, I woke up at two in the morning because I heard a strange {1} in the kitchen. My heart beat fast. I {2} the blanket over my head and waited. Was it a thief? Was it a ghost? Finally, I picked up my phone and turned on its {3} light. I walked slowly to the kitchen. There, in front of the open fridge, stood my little brother with a big bowl of ice cream. "Don't tell Mom," he whispered. "I {4} going to bed hungry." I laughed and took a spoon, too. We ate together in the dark and tried not to make any noise. Before we went back to bed, I said, "OK, but you have to {5} your teeth again."

blanks.why: a strange sound「奇怪的聲音」：聽到廚房有怪聲。death（死亡）、brush（刷子）、decision（決定）都不是能「聽到」的東西。
pull + 物 + over…「把…拉到…上面」：把被子拉過頭。hated、guessed 接 the blanket over my head 意思不通；arrive 是不及物動詞，不能接受詞。
bright light「明亮的光」：打開手機的亮光。afraid 不能放在名詞前面，angry（生氣的）、delicious（好吃的）都不能形容光。
hate + V-ing「討厭做…」：我討厭餓著肚子睡覺。brush、kick、borrow 都不能接 going to bed hungry。
brush your teeth「刷牙」：吃完冰要再刷一次牙。hate、guess、shout 接 your teeth 意思都不通。

passages.zh: 上星期五，我凌晨兩點醒來，因為我聽到廚房有奇怪的聲音。我的心跳得好快。我把被子拉過頭，靜靜等著。是小偷嗎？還是鬼？最後，我拿起手機，打開它明亮的燈光，慢慢走向廚房。結果在打開的冰箱前面，站著我弟弟，手上拿著一大碗冰淇淋。「不要跟媽媽說，」他小聲說，「我討厭餓著肚子睡覺。」我笑了，也拿了一根湯匙。我們在黑暗中一起吃，盡量不發出聲音。回去睡覺之前，我說：「好吧，但你得再刷一次牙。」

passages.title: 記者來採訪阿嬤的豆花店
passages.text: Grandma has sold tofu pudding in our town for forty years. Last week, a TV reporter came to {1} her. Grandma was very nervous. She {2} her gray hair three times and put on her best shirt. The reporter asked, "What is the secret of your tofu pudding?" Grandma smiled. "I cook the sweet beans fresh every morning. I {3} using old beans." Then the camera turned to me. I was so shy that I couldn't make a {4}. I just waved my hand and ran into the kitchen. The show was on TV on Sunday night. The next day, there was a long line in front of the shop. Many {5} from Taipei and Tainan waited for over an hour. Grandma said, "I'm tired, but I'm happy. Now everyone knows our little town."

blanks.why: interview + 人「採訪某人」：記者來採訪阿嬤。hate（討厭）意思不合；arrive 是不及物動詞，不能接 her；borrow her（借她）也不通。
brush her hair「梳頭髮」：她緊張得梳了三次頭髮。kicked、shouted、wished 接 her gray hair 意思都不通。
hate + V-ing「討厭做…」：她不喜歡用不新鮮的豆子。wish 後面不能直接接 V-ing；kick、guess 接 using old beans 也不通。
can't make a sound「發不出聲音、一句話都說不出來」。make a death、make a visitor、make a level 都不是正確的說法。
strangers「陌生人」：很多不認識的人從台北、台南來排隊。deaths（死亡）、brushes（刷子）、villages（村莊）都不能排隊等一小時。

passages.zh: 阿嬤在我們鎮上賣豆花已經四十年了。上週，一位電視台記者來採訪她。阿嬤非常緊張，把灰白的頭髮梳了三次，還穿上她最好的襯衫。記者問：「您的豆花有什麼祕訣？」阿嬤笑著說：「我每天早上都煮新鮮的甜豆，我討厭用放久的豆子。」接著鏡頭轉向我。我害羞到一個字都說不出來，只揮了揮手就跑進廚房。節目在星期天晚上播出。隔天，店門口排了一條長長的隊伍，很多從台北和台南來的陌生人等了一個多小時。阿嬤說：「我很累，但很開心。現在大家都知道我們這個小鎮了。」

passages.title: 守門員是我的雙胞胎
passages.text: My twin sister Amy and I both play soccer, but on different teams. Last Saturday, our teams played against each other in the final game. It was a cold day, but the sun was {1}. With one minute left, the score was 1 to 1. Then the referee gave my team a penalty. I put the ball down and looked at the goalkeeper. It was Amy! For a second, I {2} I could close my eyes and run away. But my teammates were watching. I ran up and {3} the ball as hard as I could. Amy jumped to the left, but the ball went to the right. Goal! My teammates shouted, but I didn't feel happy. Amy was lying on the grass. I walked over and {4} her up. She smiled at me. "Don't worry. I {5} losing, but I'm proud of you."

blanks.why: The sun was bright.「陽光很耀眼」。delicious（好吃的）、national（國家的）、hungry（餓的）都不能形容太陽。
wish + 子句「真希望…」（常表示做不到的事）：我真希望能閉上眼睛逃走。brushed、pulled、kicked 後面不能接子句。
kick the ball「踢球」：用力把球踢出去。wished、hated、interviewed 接 the ball 意思不通。
pull + 人 + up「把某人拉起來」：把躺在草地上的 Amy 拉起來。kicked、hated、wished 都不是扶人起來的動作。
hate + V-ing「討厭做…」：我討厭輸，但我以你為榮。wish 後面不能直接接 V-ing；pull、brush 接 losing 意思不通。

gloss: 罰球（足球的十二碼罰球）
passages.zh: 我的雙胞胎姊姊 Amy 和我都踢足球，但在不同的隊伍。上星期六，我們兩隊在決賽中對上了。那天很冷，但陽光很耀眼。比賽剩一分鐘時，比數是一比一。接著裁判判給我們隊一個罰球。我把球放好，看向守門員——竟然是 Amy！有一瞬間，我真希望能閉上眼睛逃走。但隊友們都在看著。我衝上前，用盡全力把球踢出去。Amy 往左撲，球卻往右飛。進球了！隊友們大聲歡呼，我卻一點也不開心。Amy 躺在草地上，我走過去把她拉起來。她對我笑了笑：「別擔心，我討厭輸球，但我以你為榮。」

passages.title: 不要跟陌生人走
passages.text: My mom always tells my little sister, "Never go anywhere with a {1}." One afternoon, I took my sister to the park near our home. A man in a {2} yellow jacket walked up to us. "Hi, little girl! Do you want to see my puppy? It's in my car," he said. My sister started to walk toward him, but I {3} her back by the hand. "We don't know you," I said loudly. Then I took out my phone and called Dad. The man quickly walked away. Later, the police told us that he had tried the same trick with other kids. At home, Mom hugged us both. "You did the right thing," she said. "If someone scares you, make a loud {4} and run to an adult. I {5} every child knew that."

blanks.why: stranger「陌生人」：不要跟陌生人去任何地方。go with a death／sound／wish（跟死亡、聲音、願望走）都不通。
bright yellow「亮黃色的」：穿著亮黃色外套的男人。afraid 不能放在名詞前；national（國家的）、delicious（好吃的）不能形容外套顏色。
pull + 人 + back「把某人拉回來」：我拉著妹妹的手把她拉回來。guessed、smelled 接 her back 意思不通；arrive 不能接受詞。
make a loud sound「發出很大的聲音」：被嚇到就大聲叫。make a loud stranger／brush／death 都不通。
wish + 子句（動詞用過去式）「真希望…」：真希望每個孩子都知道。hate 後面不接這種子句；kick、pull 也不能接子句。

passages.zh: 我媽媽總是對我妹妹說：「絕對不要跟陌生人去任何地方。」有一天下午，我帶妹妹去家附近的公園。一個穿著亮黃色外套的男人走過來。「嗨，小妹妹！想不想看我的小狗？牠在我車上。」他說。妹妹開始朝他走過去，但我拉著她的手把她拉了回來。「我們不認識你。」我大聲說，接著拿出手機打給爸爸。那個男人很快就走掉了。後來警察告訴我們，他也用同樣的手法騙過其他小孩。回到家，媽媽抱住我們兩個。「你們做得很對，」她說，「如果有人嚇到你，就大聲叫，然後跑去找大人。真希望每個孩子都知道這件事。」

passages.title: 恐龍為什麼消失了
passages.text: The {1} of the dinosaurs is still one of the biggest mysteries in history. Most scientists believe that a huge rock from space {2} the Earth about 66 million years ago. The rock made a {3} flash in the sky, and the ground shook for days. After that, dust covered the sky for years. Without sunlight, plants died, and the animals that ate them could not find food. Many people {4} they could see a real dinosaur. In a way, they already can. Some small dinosaurs did not die. Over time, they changed and became birds! So the next time you hear the {5} of a bird singing outside your window, remember: you are listening to a tiny dinosaur. Isn't that amazing?

blanks.why: the death of …「…的死亡、滅絕」：恐龍的滅絕是一大謎題。sound（聲音）、stranger（陌生人）、interview（訪問）都不能說明恐龍發生了什麼事。
hit「撞擊」：一顆巨大的隕石撞上地球。kicked（踢）、brushed（刷）、wished（希望）都不能描述石頭撞地球。
a bright flash「一道耀眼的閃光」。afraid 不能放在名詞前；busy（忙碌的）、delicious（好吃的）不能形容閃光。
wish + 子句「真希望…」：很多人希望能看到真的恐龍。hate、kick、pull 都不能接 they could see… 這種子句。
the sound of …「…的聲音」：聽到鳥叫聲。death、stranger、brush 都不是能「聽到」的東西。

passages.zh: 恐龍的滅絕至今仍是歷史上最大的謎題之一。大部分科學家相信，大約六千六百萬年前，一顆來自太空的巨大岩石撞上了地球。這顆岩石在天空中發出一道耀眼的閃光，地面搖晃了好幾天。之後，灰塵遮住天空好多年。沒有陽光，植物死了，吃植物的動物也找不到食物。很多人希望能看到真正的恐龍。某種程度上，他們已經看得到了。有些小型恐龍沒有死，經過很長的時間，牠們慢慢改變，變成了鳥！所以下次你聽到窗外的鳥叫聲時，記得：你正在聽一隻小小的恐龍唱歌。是不是很神奇？

passages.title: 姊姊的第一次面試
passages.text: My sister Jenny had her first job {1} at a bank on Monday. On Sunday night, she was so nervous that she couldn't sleep. She was {2} that she would say something wrong. She kept talking to the mirror: "Hello, my name is Jenny Wang..." The next morning, she {3} her hair carefully and put on a black suit. Before she left, Mom held her hands. "Just smile and be yourself," she said. "Don't let the {4} in the room scare you. They were nervous at their first interview, too." In the afternoon, Jenny called home. "They want me!" she shouted. That night, we had a big dinner to celebrate. Dad gave her a card. It said, "Best {5} for your new job!"

blanks.why: job interview「工作面試」。death（死亡）、brush（刷子）、stranger（陌生人）都不能和 job 組成要去銀行參加的活動。
be afraid that + 子句「害怕…」：她怕自己會說錯話。national、useful、delicious 都不能接 that 子句表示擔心。
brush her hair「梳頭髮」。kicked、hated、guessed 接 her hair 意思都不通。
strangers「陌生人」：別讓房間裡不認識的人（面試官）嚇到你。deaths、brushes、villages 都不能坐在房間裡面試別人。
Best wishes「祝福你、獻上最好的祝福」，卡片上常用。Best deaths／sounds／kicks 都不通。

passages.zh: 我姊姊 Jenny 星期一要去一家銀行參加她的第一次工作面試。星期天晚上，她緊張到睡不著，很怕自己會說錯話。她一直對著鏡子練習：「您好，我叫王 Jenny……」隔天早上，她仔細梳好頭髮，穿上黑色套裝。出門前，媽媽握著她的手說：「笑一笑，做你自己就好。別讓房間裡的陌生人嚇到你，他們第一次面試時也很緊張。」下午，Jenny 打電話回家，大喊：「他們錄取我了！」那天晚上我們吃了一頓大餐慶祝。爸爸給她一張卡片，上面寫著：「祝你新工作一切順利！」

passages.title: 和 905 班拔河
passages.text: On Sports Day, our class had a tug-of-war game against Class 905. Everyone {1} the rope tightly. When the teacher blew the whistle, we started to {2} as hard as we could. Class 905 was strong. Their biggest boy, Leo, made a loud {3} like an angry bear. Our feet began to slide on the grass. I {4} I had more power in my arms. Then our class leader shouted, "One, two, go! One, two, go!" We moved together, step by step. Finally, Leo fell down, and we won! After the game, Leo came over and shook my hand. His face was red, but his smile was {5}. "You guys were great," he said. "But next year, we'll win." We all laughed together.

blanks.why: hold the rope「抓住繩子」：每個人都緊緊握住繩子。smelled、guessed、hosted 接 the rope 意思不通。
pull「拉」：拔河就是用力拉。brush（刷）、interview（採訪）、hate（討厭）都不是拔河的動作。
make a loud sound「發出很大的聲音」：Leo 像生氣的熊一樣大吼。make a loud death／wish／stranger 都不通。
wish + 子句「真希望…」：真希望我手臂更有力。pulled、kicked、brushed 後面不能接子句。
His smile was bright.「笑容很燦爛」。afraid（害怕的）、national（國家的）、wet（濕的）都不能形容笑容。

passages.zh: 運動會那天，我們班和 905 班比拔河。每個人都緊緊握住繩子。老師一吹哨，我們就開始用盡全力拉。905 班很強，他們班最高大的男生 Leo 像一隻生氣的熊一樣大吼。我們的腳開始在草地上打滑，我真希望自己的手臂更有力。這時班長大喊：「一、二，衝！一、二，衝！」我們一起出力，一步一步往後退。最後 Leo 跌倒了，我們贏了！比賽結束後，Leo 走過來跟我握手。他的臉紅紅的，笑容卻很燦爛。「你們很厲害，」他說，「不過明年我們會贏。」我們大家一起笑了。

passages.title: 小美人魚的願望
passages.text: Ariel was a young mermaid who lived under the sea. She had a beautiful voice, but she had one {1}: to walk on land. One night, she saw a ship in a storm. A young prince fell into the sea. Ariel swam fast and {2} him to the beach. Before the prince woke up, she sang to him and then swam away. He only remembered a sweet {3} from the sea. Later, Ariel went to a sea witch. The witch said, "I can give you legs, but you must give me your voice." Ariel agreed. On land, she met the prince again, but she could not speak. To him, she was just a {4}. Every night, Ariel sat by the sea and {5} her long red hair. She still believed that love could be shown without words.

blanks.why: one wish「一個願望」：她的願望是在陸地上走路。death、stranger、brush 都不能用冒號接「想在陸地上走」來說明。
pull + 人 + to…「把某人拉到…」：把王子拉到海灘上。guessed、hated 接 him to the beach 意思不通；shout 不能這樣接受詞和地點。
a sweet sound「甜美的聲音」：王子只記得海上傳來的歌聲。death、stranger、brush 都不能用 sweet 形容成歌聲。
stranger「陌生人」：王子不知道是她救了他，她只是個陌生人。sound、wish、death 都不能用來說「她是誰」。
brush her hair「梳頭髮」。kicked、interviewed 接 her hair 意思不通；arrive 不能接受詞。

passages.zh: Ariel 是一條住在海底的年輕美人魚。她有一副好歌喉，但她有一個願望：在陸地上走路。一天晚上，她看見一艘船遇上暴風雨，一位年輕的王子掉進海裡。Ariel 很快游過去，把他拉到海灘上。在王子醒來之前，她對他唱了一首歌，然後游走了。王子只記得海上傳來一個甜美的聲音。後來，Ariel 去找海女巫。女巫說：「我可以給你雙腿，但你得把聲音給我。」Ariel 答應了。到了陸地上，她又見到王子，卻不能說話。對王子來說，她只是個陌生人。每天晚上，Ariel 坐在海邊梳著她紅色的長髮。她仍然相信，愛不用言語也能表達。

passages.title: 討厭香菜的爸爸
passages.text: My dad {1} cilantro. He says it tastes like soap. Last weekend, we went to a famous noodle shop. Dad told the owner, "No cilantro, please." But when the bowl {2}, there was something green on top! Dad's face turned red. He used his chopsticks to {3} out every little leaf. It took him ten minutes. While he was doing it, he made a funny {4}, like an angry duck. Then the owner walked over and said, "Sorry, sir, that's not cilantro. That's green onion." Everyone laughed, even Dad. The owner smiled. "I {5} all my customers were as careful as you," he said, and he gave Dad a free tea egg. Dad ate it happily.

blanks.why: hate「討厭」：爸爸討厭香菜。wishes、kicks、pulls 接 cilantro 意思都不通。
arrive「到達、送來」：麵送來的時候。kicked、brushed、wished 後面少了受詞，也不能表示「送到」。
pull out「拔出、挑出」：用筷子把每片葉子挑出來。kick out（踢出去）、hate out、interview out 都不能用筷子做。
make a funny sound「發出好笑的聲音」。make a funny stranger／death／wish 都不通。
wish + 子句（動詞用過去式）「真希望…」：真希望客人都像你這麼仔細。hate、pull、kick 都不能接這種子句。

passages.zh: 我爸爸討厭香菜，他說香菜吃起來像肥皂。上週末，我們去一家有名的麵店。爸爸跟老闆說：「不要香菜，謝謝。」但麵送來時，上面竟然有綠綠的東西！爸爸的臉都紅了，他用筷子把每一片小葉子挑出來，花了十分鐘。他一邊挑一邊發出好笑的聲音，像一隻生氣的鴨子。這時老闆走過來說：「先生，不好意思，那不是香菜，是蔥。」大家都笑了，連爸爸也笑了。老闆笑著說：「真希望我的客人都像您這麼仔細。」然後送了爸爸一顆免費的茶葉蛋。爸爸開心地把它吃掉了。

passages.title: 把房間刷成黃色
passages.text: The walls of my room were old and gray, so Dad and I decided to paint them. We bought two big {1} and a can of yellow paint. "Yellow will make your room {2}," Dad said. First, we had to move the bed. It was heavy, so I {3} and Dad pushed. Painting was harder than I thought. Paint got on my face, my hair, and even on my cat! By the evening, my arms hurt, and I started to {4} the whole idea. But when I saw the finished room, I changed my mind. It looked like a sunny morning. "I {5} we could paint the whole house," I said. Dad laughed and showed me his yellow hands. "Not this weekend!"

blanks.why: brushes「刷子」：買了兩支大刷子和一桶油漆。deaths、sounds、strangers 都不能買來刷牆。
make + 物 + 形容詞「使…變得…」：黃色會讓房間明亮。afraid（害怕的）、hungry（餓的）、delicious（好吃的）都不能形容房間。
pull「拉」：我拉、爸爸推，一起搬床。wished、hated、guessed 都不是搬床的動作。
hate the idea「討厭這個主意」：手痠到開始討厭刷油漆這件事。wish、kick、brush 接 the whole idea 意思不通。
wish + 子句「真希望…」：真希望能把整間房子都刷一遍。hate、pull、kick 都不能接子句。

passages.zh: 我房間的牆壁又舊又灰，所以爸爸和我決定把它粉刷一下。我們買了兩支大刷子和一桶黃色油漆。「黃色會讓你的房間變明亮。」爸爸說。首先，我們得把床移開。床很重，所以我拉、爸爸推。刷油漆比我想的還難，油漆沾到我的臉、頭髮，甚至沾到我的貓！到了傍晚，我的手臂好痠，開始討厭這整個主意。但當我看到完成的房間，我改變了想法——它看起來就像一個陽光燦爛的早晨。「真希望我們能把整間房子都刷一遍。」我說。爸爸笑著讓我看他黃色的雙手：「這個週末不行！」

passages.title: 寵物店的鸚鵡 Kiwi
passages.text: There is a pet shop next to my school. In the window, there is a green parrot named Kiwi. Kiwi can copy almost any {1}: a phone ringing, a dog barking, and even a baby crying. Kiwi is friendly to kids, but he {2} cats. When a cat walks by, he shouts, "Go away! Go away!" One day, a {3} in a black coat walked into the shop and asked, "How much is this bird?" The owner told him the price. Before the man could {4} out his wallet, Kiwi shouted in the owner's voice, "No! He's my best friend!" The man laughed and left the shop. The owner smiled at Kiwi. "Well, it looks like you have made your {5}," he said. "You're staying with me."

blanks.why: copy any sound「模仿任何聲音」：後面舉的例子都是聲音。death、stranger、interview 都不能被鸚鵡模仿成電話聲、狗叫聲。
hate「討厭」：牠討厭貓，看到貓就大叫。wishes、guesses 接 cats 意思不通；arrive 不能接受詞。
stranger「陌生人」：一個穿黑大衣、不認識的人走進店裡。sound、death、wish 都不能穿大衣走進來。
pull out「拿出、掏出」：那個人還沒掏出錢包。guess out、arrive out、hate out 都不通。
make a decision「做決定」：看來你已經做好決定了。make a death／stranger／brush 都不是正確說法。

passages.zh: 我學校旁邊有一家寵物店，櫥窗裡有一隻叫 Kiwi 的綠色鸚鵡。Kiwi 幾乎能模仿任何聲音：電話鈴聲、狗叫聲，甚至嬰兒的哭聲。Kiwi 對小孩很友善，但牠討厭貓，只要有貓經過，牠就大叫：「走開！走開！」有一天，一個穿著黑色大衣的陌生人走進店裡，問：「這隻鳥多少錢？」老闆告訴他價錢。那個人還沒掏出錢包，Kiwi 就用老闆的聲音大喊：「不要！牠是我最好的朋友！」那個人笑了笑，離開了店裡。老闆對 Kiwi 笑著說：「看來你已經做好決定了。你要留下來陪我。」

passages.title: 跆拳道考黑帶
passages.text: I have learned taekwondo for five years. Last Saturday, I took my black belt test. The room was quiet, and the {1} lights made me sweat. First, I had to show five different {2}. I {3} high and fast, and my teacher nodded. Next was the hardest part: breaking a wooden board with my hand. I took a deep breath and hit it. Crack! The {4} was so loud that my mom jumped in her seat. I passed! After the test, my teacher put the black belt around me. "You used to {5} practicing every day," he said, "but you never stopped coming. That's why you are here today." I will never forget those words.

blanks.why: bright lights「明亮（刺眼）的燈光」。afraid 不能放在名詞前；hungry（餓的）、national（國家的）都不能形容燈光。
kicks「踢法」：要展示五種不同的踢腿動作。deaths、wishes、strangers 都不能「表演」出來給老師看。
kick high「踢得很高」：又高又快地踢。brushed、wished、interviewed 都不能用 high and fast 形容成考試動作。
sound「聲音」：「喀」一聲大到媽媽嚇一跳。death、stranger、wish 都不能用「大聲」來形容。
used to hate + V-ing「以前討厭做…」：你以前討厭每天練習。wish 後面不能直接接 V-ing；pull、brush 接 practicing 意思不通。

passages.zh: 我學跆拳道已經五年了。上星期六，我參加了黑帶考試。考場很安靜，明亮的燈光讓我直冒汗。首先，我要展示五種不同的踢法。我踢得又高又快，老師點了點頭。接下來是最難的部分：用手劈斷一塊木板。我深吸一口氣，一掌劈下去。「喀！」聲音大到媽媽在座位上嚇了一跳。我通過了！考完試，老師幫我繫上黑帶。他說：「你以前很討厭每天練習，但你從來沒有停止來上課。這就是你今天能站在這裡的原因。」我永遠不會忘記這句話。

passages.title: 校刊專訪工友陳伯伯
passages.text: I write for our school newspaper. This month, I wanted to {1} someone special: Uncle Chen, our school's cleaner. Every morning, he comes at six and {2} the floors of the hallways. At first, Uncle Chen didn't want to talk. "I'm just a cleaner," he said. But when I asked about the old tree in the schoolyard, his eyes became {3}. He told me he planted that tree forty years ago, when he was a student here! "Many students think I'm a {4}," he said, "but this school is my home." After my story came out, many students started to say hello to him. Now he always laughs and says, "I {5} you had come to talk to me years ago!"

blanks.why: interview + 人「採訪某人」：這個月想採訪一位特別的人。kick、pull、brush 都不是寫校刊要對人做的事。
brush the floors「刷洗地板」：他每天早上刷洗走廊地板。wishes 接 the floors 不通；arrive、shout 後面不能直接接受詞。
eyes became bright「眼睛亮了起來」：談到老樹時他很有興趣。afraid（害怕的）、national（國家的）、useful（有用的）都不能說明他高興起來。
stranger「陌生人」：很多學生以為他是不相干的外人。sound、death、brush 都不能用來說一個人是什麼。
wish + 子句（had + 過去分詞）「真希望當初…」：真希望你幾年前就來找我聊天。hate、kick、pull 都不能接這種子句。

passages.zh: 我在學校的校刊寫稿。這個月，我想採訪一位特別的人：學校的工友陳伯伯。他每天早上六點就來學校刷洗走廊的地板。一開始，陳伯伯不想多談。「我只是個工友。」他說。但當我問起校園裡那棵老樹時，他的眼睛亮了起來。他告訴我，那棵樹是他四十年前還在這裡當學生時種的！「很多學生把我當成陌生人，」他說，「但這所學校就是我的家。」我的報導刊出之後，很多同學開始跟他打招呼。現在他總是笑著說：「真希望你們好幾年前就來找我聊天！」

passages.title: 合歡山的流星雨
passages.text: Last August, my family drove to Hehuan Mountain to watch a meteor shower. We {1} at the top at midnight. It was very cold, and the sky was full of {2} stars. We lay on a blanket and waited. Suddenly, a long line of light went across the sky. "Quick! Make a {3}!" Mom said. I closed my eyes. I {4} for good grades on the exam. My little brother wished for a dog. Then we heard a strange {5} behind us. It was Dad's stomach! Everyone laughed. "OK, my wish is a hot bowl of beef noodles," Dad said. On the way down the mountain, we stopped at a small shop, and his wish came true first. It was the best bowl of noodles ever.

blanks.why: arrive at…「抵達…」：半夜抵達山頂。kicked、brushed、hated 後面都不能接 at the top 表示到達。
bright stars「明亮的星星」。afraid 不能放在名詞前；busy（忙碌的）、angry（生氣的）都不能形容星星。
make a wish「許願」：看到流星快許願。make a death／stranger／brush 都不是正確說法。
wish for + 名詞「希望得到…」：我許願考試考好。hate for、kick for、pull for 都不能表示許願。
a strange sound「奇怪的聲音」：聽到背後有怪聲，原來是爸爸肚子叫。death、brush、decision 都不能「聽到」。

passages.zh: 去年八月，我們全家開車到合歡山看流星雨。我們半夜才抵達山頂。天氣非常冷，天空滿是明亮的星星。我們躺在毯子上等待。突然，一道長長的光劃過天空。「快！許願！」媽媽說。我閉上眼睛，許願考試能考好。弟弟許願想要一隻狗。接著我們聽到背後傳來一個奇怪的聲音——原來是爸爸的肚子在叫！大家都笑了。「好吧，我的願望是一碗熱騰騰的牛肉麵。」爸爸說。下山的路上，我們在一家小店停下來，結果爸爸的願望最先實現了。那是我吃過最好吃的一碗麵。

passages.title: 拔牙的那一天
passages.text: I had a bad tooth in the back of my mouth. Last week, the dentist said, "I have to {1} it out." I was so {2} that my hands were shaking. When I lay down in the chair, the machine next to me made a terrible {3}. I closed my eyes and held Mom's hand. But it didn't hurt at all! After five minutes, the dentist showed me the tooth. It was black and full of holes. "This is what happens when you don't {4} your teeth well," she said. On the way home, I couldn't eat anything, and my face looked like a balloon. I looked at Mom and said, "I {5} I had listened to you about candy."

blanks.why: pull out a tooth「拔牙」：我必須把它拔掉。wish、hate、interview 接 it out 都不通。
so afraid that…「害怕到…」：怕到手都在發抖。useful（有用的）、national（國家的）、delicious（好吃的）都不能說明手發抖的原因。
make a terrible sound「發出可怕的聲音」：牙醫的機器聲很嚇人。death、stranger、wish 都不能被機器「發出」。
brush your teeth「刷牙」：沒好好刷牙就會蛀牙。hate、kick、guess 接 your teeth 意思不通。
wish + 子句（had + 過去分詞）「真希望當初…」：真希望當初有聽你的話少吃糖。hate、kick、pull 不能接這種子句。

passages.zh: 我嘴巴後面有一顆蛀牙。上週，牙醫說：「我得把它拔掉。」我害怕到雙手都在發抖。我躺上診療椅時，旁邊的機器發出很可怕的聲音。我閉上眼睛，握住媽媽的手。但是一點也不痛！五分鐘後，牙醫讓我看那顆牙，它又黑又滿是洞。「這就是沒有好好刷牙的下場。」她說。回家的路上，我什麼都不能吃，臉腫得像顆氣球。我看著媽媽說：「真希望我當初有聽你的話，少吃點糖。」

passages.title: 阿拉丁的最後一個願望
passages.text: Aladdin was a poor boy. One day, he found an old lamp in a cave. When he cleaned it, a {1} blue light came out, and a genie appeared. "You saved me," said the genie. "I will give you three {2}." Aladdin's first wish was to become a prince. His second wish was to save his friend from a bad man. Then he looked at the genie. The genie had lived in the lamp for a thousand years, and he looked tired. So Aladdin {3} to use his last wish for the genie. He {4} the lamp out of his bag and said, "Genie, I wish you were free." The genie was so happy that he made a loud {5} like thunder and flew around the sky. "You are the best friend I have ever had," he said.

blanks.why: a bright blue light「明亮的藍光」從神燈冒出來。afraid 不能放在名詞前；hungry（餓的）、delicious（好吃的）不能形容光。
three wishes「三個願望」：神燈精靈給他三個願望，後面也說 first wish、second wish。deaths、sounds、strangers 都不對。
decide to + V「決定做…」：他決定把最後一個願望用在精靈身上。guessed、smelled、hosted 後面不能接 to use。
pull + 物 + out of…「把…從…拿出來」：把神燈從袋子裡拿出來。guessed、hated 接 the lamp out of his bag 意思不通；arrive 不能接受詞。
make a loud sound「發出很大的聲音」：精靈開心得發出雷聲般的巨響。make a loud death／stranger／brush 都不通。

passages.zh: 阿拉丁是一個窮人家的男孩。有一天，他在洞穴裡發現一盞舊燈。他擦拭燈的時候，一道明亮的藍光冒了出來，一個精靈出現了。「你救了我，」精靈說，「我會給你三個願望。」阿拉丁的第一個願望是成為王子，第二個願望是從壞人手中救出他的朋友。接著他看著精靈。精靈已經在燈裡住了一千年，看起來很疲憊。於是阿拉丁決定把最後一個願望用在精靈身上。他把神燈從袋子裡拿出來，說：「精靈，我希望你自由。」精靈開心得發出像雷一樣的巨響，在天空中飛來飛去。「你是我有過最好的朋友。」他說。

passages.title: 毒舌評審的一句話
passages.text: Our school held a singing contest, and a famous singer came to be the judge. He was known for his honest words. The first singer was very nervous, and her voice {1} weak. The judge said, "I don't {2} your song, but you need more practice." Then it was my turn. My legs were shaking. I {3} the microphone closer and sang my favorite song, a slow song about my grandma. When I finished, the room was quiet. Then the judge stood up and clapped. "Your voice is like a {4} morning after the rain," he said. I didn't win first place, but his words were the best gift I got that year. I {5} I could hear them again.

blanks.why: sound + 形容詞「聽起來…」：她的聲音聽起來很微弱。kicked、brushed、pulled 都不能接 weak 表示聽起來如何。
I don't hate…「我不討厭…」：我不討厭你的歌，但你需要多練習。wish 不能直接接 your song；kick、pull 接 your song 意思不通。
pull + 物 + closer「把…拉近」：把麥克風拉近一點。wished、hated、guessed 接 the microphone closer 都不通。
a bright morning「晴朗明亮的早晨」：評審稱讚歌聲像雨後的晴朗早晨。afraid 不能放在名詞前；national、hungry 不能形容早晨。
wish + 子句「真希望…」：真希望能再聽一次那些話。hate、kick、pull 都不能接子句。

passages.zh: 我們學校舉辦歌唱比賽，一位知名歌手來當評審。他以說話直白出名。第一位參賽者非常緊張，她的聲音聽起來很微弱。評審說：「我不討厭你的歌，但你需要多練習。」接著輪到我了，我的腳一直在抖。我把麥克風拉近，唱了我最喜歡的歌，一首關於我外婆的慢歌。唱完後，全場一片安靜。接著評審站起來鼓掌。「你的聲音就像雨後晴朗的早晨。」他說。我沒有得到第一名，但他的話是我那年收到最好的禮物。真希望能再聽一次那句話。

passages.title: 老狗阿福
passages.text: Our dog Afu was fifteen years old. He was slow, and he slept most of the day. Every evening, I {1} his soft brown fur and told him about my day. Last month, Afu stopped eating. A week later, he died quietly in his sleep. His {2} made the whole family very sad. For days, the house felt too quiet. I missed the {3} of his feet on the floor. I even started to {4} coming home after school. Then Grandma sat down with me. "Afu had a happy life because you loved him," she said. "He wouldn't want you to cry every day." She was right. Now, when I see a {5} star at night, I smile and say goodnight to Afu.

blanks.why: brush his fur「梳牠的毛」：每天晚上幫阿福梳毛。kicked（踢）、hated（討厭）、interviewed（採訪）都不是疼愛狗狗的動作。
his death「牠的死」：阿福的離開讓全家很難過。sound、wish、stranger 都不能說明讓全家難過的事。
the sound of his feet「牠腳步的聲音」：想念牠走在地板上的聲音。death、wish、stranger 都不能「聽到」。
hate + V-ing「討厭做…」：甚至開始討厭放學回家。wish 後面不能直接接 V-ing；brush、kick 接 coming home 不通。
a bright star「明亮的星星」。afraid 不能放在名詞前；hungry、delicious 不能形容星星。

passages.zh: 我們家的狗阿福十五歲了，牠動作很慢，一天大部分的時間都在睡覺。每天晚上，我都會梳梳牠柔軟的棕色毛，跟牠說我這一天發生的事。上個月，阿福不再吃東西。一週後，牠在睡夢中安靜地走了。牠的離開讓全家人都非常難過。好幾天，家裡安靜得讓人難受，我好想念牠的腳步走在地板上的聲音，甚至開始討厭放學回家。後來奶奶坐到我身邊。「阿福這一生很快樂，因為你愛牠，」她說，「牠不會希望你每天哭的。」她說得對。現在，每當我在夜裡看到一顆明亮的星星，我就會微笑著跟阿福說晚安。

passages.title: 捷運上迷路的旅客
passages.text: Last Sunday, I took the MRT to Taipei Main Station. A tall {1} with a big backpack stood next to me. He was looking at a map and seemed lost. I wanted to help, but I was {2} my English wasn't good enough. Finally, I said, "Excuse me, can I help you?" He smiled. "Yes! Does this train go to Tamsui?" "No, you need to change trains at the next station," I said. When the train stopped, I helped him {3} his heavy suitcase out of the train. Then we heard the {4} of the next train coming, and he ran to catch it. "Thank you!" he shouted. On the way home, I felt proud. My English wasn't perfect, but it was {5}.

blanks.why: stranger「陌生人」：一個背著大背包、不認識的高個子站在我旁邊。death、sound、wish 都不能「站在旁邊看地圖」。
be afraid (that) + 子句「怕…」：我怕自己英文不夠好。useful、national、delicious 都不能接子句表示擔心。
help + 人 + 原形動詞「幫某人做…」：幫他把重行李箱拉出車廂。wish、hate、guess 接 his heavy suitcase out 都不通。
the sound of the next train「下一班車進站的聲音」。death、stranger、wish 都不能「聽到」火車來。
useful「有用的」：英文雖然不完美，但很有用（幫到了人）。afraid、national、delicious 都不能說明英文的功用。

passages.zh: 上星期天，我搭捷運到台北車站。一個背著大背包的高個子陌生人站在我旁邊，他看著地圖，好像迷路了。我想幫忙，但又怕自己的英文不夠好。最後我說：「不好意思，需要幫忙嗎？」他笑了：「要！這班車有到淡水嗎？」「沒有，你要在下一站換車。」我說。列車停下時，我幫他把沉重的行李箱拉出車廂。接著我們聽到下一班車進站的聲音，他趕緊跑去搭。「謝謝你！」他大喊。回家的路上，我覺得很驕傲。我的英文雖然不完美，但真的派上了用場。

passages.title: 會踢人的驢子 Lucky
passages.text: My uncle has a farm in Taitung. He has a donkey named Lucky. Lucky looks cute, but he {1} strangers. Uncle warned me, "Never stand behind him. He will {2} you." But my cousin Jack didn't listen. He wanted to {3} Lucky's tail for a funny photo. Bang! Lucky kicked him into a big pile of hay. Jack made a strange {4}, like a cat in the rain. Luckily, he was fine, just covered in hay from head to toe. Uncle laughed and helped him up. "Well, now Lucky won't think you're a {5} anymore," he said. "You two have met in a very special way!" Jack didn't think it was funny at all, but he never went near Lucky's tail again.

blanks.why: hate「討厭」：Lucky 討厭陌生人。wishes、brushes、interviews 接 strangers 都說不通。
kick + 人「踢某人」：站在驢子後面會被踢。wish you、interview you 不合語意；arrive 不能接受詞。
pull the tail「拉尾巴」：想拉驢子的尾巴拍好笑的照片。wish、guess 接 Lucky's tail 不通；arrive 不能接受詞。
make a strange sound「發出奇怪的聲音」：Jack 叫得像淋雨的貓。death、stranger、wish 都不能被「發出」。
stranger「陌生人」：現在 Lucky 不會再把你當陌生人了。sound、wish、death 都不能用來說「你是誰」。

passages.zh: 我叔叔在台東有一座農場，他養了一隻叫 Lucky 的驢子。Lucky 看起來很可愛，但牠討厭陌生人。叔叔警告我：「千萬別站在牠後面，牠會踢你。」但我的表哥 Jack 不聽。他想拉 Lucky 的尾巴，拍一張好笑的照片。砰！Lucky 一腳把他踢進一大堆乾草裡。Jack 發出一聲怪叫，像隻淋雨的貓。幸好他沒事，只是從頭到腳都沾滿了乾草。叔叔笑著把他扶起來。「好啦，現在 Lucky 不會再把你當陌生人了，」他說，「你們用很特別的方式認識了彼此！」Jack 一點也不覺得好笑，但他再也不敢靠近 Lucky 的尾巴了。
